channel: 馬丁英語 English with Martin
title: 「想太多了」用英語怎麼說？
summary_zh: 中文常說的「想太多了」在英文中有多種對應說法，視情境不同而異。
key_points: You're overthinking it. — 最直接的對應，想太多
Don't overthink it. — 別想太多
You're reading too much into it. — 你過度解讀了
It's not that deep. — 沒那麼複雜（口語常用）

vocabulary.example: You're overthinking it. Just go for it!
vocabulary.example_zh: 你想太多了。就去試試吧！

vocabulary.example: Don't overthink it. The answer is simple.
You're reading too much into his message.
vocabulary.example_zh: 你把他那條訊息想得太複雜了。

vocabulary.example: A: Do you think he's mad at me? B: It's not that deep, relax.
vocabulary.example_zh: A：你覺得他在生我的氣嗎？B：沒那麼複雜，放輕鬆。

student_tip:
Think too much 雖然文法沒錯，但母語者更常用一個字 overthink。
試試看把 Don't overthink it! 變成你的口頭禪！
